guide.summary: A fast, hungry sugar eater that grows and splits quickly.
guide.biology: Many real bacteria grow quickly when simple sugars and oxygen are plentiful, and swim toward food.
guide.rules: Eats sugar using oxygen. Moves 0.25 cells per second and senses food up to 2 cells away. Splits once it has doubled its body and has spare energy. Prey for Amoeba, Ciliate, Siltworm and others; the only host of Pinphage.
guide.example: Put Sprinters next to a sugar patch and watch them spread across it, then thin out when the sugar runs low.
